decision_rule.note: With no ties the LLM arm must win at least 10 of 12 roots (p=0.0386; one win short gives p=0.146). Every tie raises the required share, and at 8 or fewer non-tied roots only unanimity can reject. At 5 or fewer non-tied roots the test cannot reject at all. The same thresholds apply symmetrically to a GP advantage, which would be reported as a disadvantage finding.

missing_data_rule: Any root with a missing arm makes the primary summary incomplete and no confirmatory claim may be made; the incomplete family is reported as such.

multiplicity.note: v1 registered two primary tests and applied Holm over that family of two. This version registers one study, so there is no family to adjust and holm_two is not applicable. Alpha is unchanged at 0.05; dropping a test does not license spending its alpha elsewhere.

practical_threshold: 0.01 normalized energy, reported alongside, never as the test
primary_estimand: Per-root direction of the paired LLM-versus-GP champion comparison on the historical task, under matched initialization, matched work ceiling and matched evaluation.
primary_test: two-sided exact sign test over the twelve registered roots
secondary_descriptive: champion versus its own initialization best, per arm
bootstrap CI for mean paired energy delta among jointly feasible roots
stopping: no interim analysis; no optional stopping; all twelve roots run
tie_rule: exact numerical ties (1e-9) are excluded from the sign test, as in v1
